title: OpenClapper · Traffic
description: Visitor traffic on openclapper.app (production, admin, staging) and openclapper.org, and Cloudflare Web Analytics. Live from Cloudflare's GraphQL API; generated by grafana/build.mjs in the deploy repository.

panels.title: openclapper.app: requests, page views and visitors per day
panels.description: Every host of the zone together, from Cloudflare's daily zone totals (kept a year). Today is partial. Visitors are unique per day, so they do not add up across days.

targets.root_selector: if ((.errors // []) | length) > 0 then error([.errors[].message] | join("; ")) else ([.data.viewer.zones[]?.httpRequests1dGroups[]? | { time: (.dimensions.date + "T00:00:00Z"), requests: (.sum.requests), pageViews: (.sum.pageViews), visitors: (.uniq.uniques), threats: (.sum.threats), bytes: (.sum.bytes), cachedShare: (if .sum.requests == 0 then 0 else .sum.cachedRequests / .sum.requests end) }] | sort_by(.time)) end

url_options.body_graphql_query: { viewer { zones(filter: { zoneTag: "229c2121dbd38d2df02496f515c8c7b4" }) { httpRequests1dGroups(limit: 400, filter: { date_geq: "${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}", date_leq: "${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}" }, orderBy: [date_ASC]) { dimensions { date } sum { requests pageViews threats cachedRequests bytes } uniq { uniques } } } } }

panels.title: In the range
panels.description: Sums of the daily totals on the left. Bandwidth is what Cloudflare sent to visitors.

panels.title: Requests per host
panels.description: Visitor requests (no Worker subrequests) per known host. Scanners on odd ports are left out here and listed in the details row. Per host, Cloudflare keeps 31 days.

targets.root_selector: if ((.errors // []) | length) > 0 then error([.errors[].message] | join("; ")) else ([.data.viewer.zones[]?.httpRequestsAdaptiveGroups[]? | { time: ((if (.dimensions.t | length) == 10 then .dimensions.t + "T00:00:00Z" else .dimensions.t end)), host: (.dimensions.clientRequestHTTPHost), requests: (.count), bytes: (.sum.edgeResponseBytes), visits: (.sum.visits) }] | sort_by(.time)) end

url_options.body_graphql_query: { viewer { zones(filter: { zoneTag: "229c2121dbd38d2df02496f515c8c7b4" }) { httpRequestsAdaptiveGroups(limit: 10000, filter: { datetime_geq: "${__from:date:iso}", datetime_leq: "${__to:date:iso}", requestSource: "eyeball", clientRequestHTTPHost_in: ["openclapper.app", "admin.openclapper.app", "staging.openclapper.app", "staging-admin.openclapper.app"] }) { count sum { edgeResponseBytes visits } dimensions { t: $__customInterval(2d,datetimeFifteenMinutes,10d,datetimeHour,date) clientRequestHTTPHost } } } } }

panels.title: Bandwidth per host
panels.description: Bytes sent to visitors, per host.

panels.title: Visits per host
panels.description: Cloudflare's visits: a request from another site or none, roughly a session start.

targets.root_selector: if ((.errors // []) | length) > 0 then error([.errors[].message] | join("; ")) else ([.data.viewer.zones[]?.httpRequestsAdaptiveGroups[]? | { time: ((if (.dimensions.t | length) == 10 then .dimensions.t + "T00:00:00Z" else .dimensions.t end)), class: (((.dimensions.edgeResponseStatus / 100 | floor | tostring) + "xx")), requests: (.count) }] | group_by([.time, .class]) | map({ time: (.[0].time), class: (.[0].class), requests: (map(.requests) | add) }) | sort_by(.time)) end

url_options.body_graphql_query: { viewer { zones(filter: { zoneTag: "229c2121dbd38d2df02496f515c8c7b4" }) { httpRequestsAdaptiveGroups(limit: 10000, filter: { datetime_geq: "${__from:date:iso}", datetime_leq: "${__to:date:iso}", requestSource: "eyeball", clientRequestHTTPHost_in: ["openclapper.app", "admin.openclapper.app", "staging.openclapper.app", "staging-admin.openclapper.app"] }) { count dimensions { t: $__customInterval(2d,datetimeFifteenMinutes,10d,datetimeHour,date) edgeResponseStatus } } } } }

panels.description: Every host of the zone, from the daily totals.

url_options.body_graphql_query: { viewer { zones(filter: { zoneTag: "229c2121dbd38d2df02496f515c8c7b4" }) { httpRequests1dGroups(limit: 400, filter: { date_geq: "${__from:date:YYYY-MM-DD}", date_leq: "${__to:date:YYYY-MM-DD}" }) { sum { countryMap { clientCountryName requests threats } } } } } }
